tasks.title: Journal `time` as ISO-8601 nanosecond string (backward-compatible decode) so JSON clients read it losslessly
tasks.instructions: journal.jsonl encodes `time` as integer nanoseconds since epoch, which exceeds 2^53 and is lossy in JSON.parse. No real journals exist yet, so change encode_report to write `time` as the same ISO-8601 string every other artifact uses, keep decode_report accepting both integer and string, add doctests for both, regenerate platform/fixtures/synthetic/paper-ma_synthetic/journal.jsonl, update docs/API.md section 1. Until merged, the run API passes journal bytes through unparsed (T-025).
